description: The main window: app name and version, open and save dialogs, the shell's own file commands, which allow only the data folder, files the user picked and their autosave folders (src/files.rs), the close-request event with destroy, so the editor can offer to save before the window closes, the media converter's commands (src/media.rs: its pinned download, a fixed conversion of a file the page may read, and cancel), and the updater's commands (src/update.rs: whether the build can update, check, download with its signature checked, cancel, and run the checked installer). Nothing else.
